notes.title: Update Patch V1.01
notes.content:
New Content：
1.Add sound effect for Dragon Mother, Engineer and new core skills.

Bug Fixed:
1. fixed the issue that the third modify introduction UI of building sometimes disappeared.
2. fixed the issue that core skill icons mismatch sometime.
3. Fixed the problem that sometimes the text does not match after switching languages.
4. Fixed an issue where the Arcane Mecha could not properly increase its stat value.

Balance Adjustments:
1. Nerfed the health of the Recovering Shaman, Spike Dragon and Big Mouse Dragon.
2. Nerfed the number of monsters in the fifth wave, tenth wave, twelfth wave, and thirteenth wave in the fifth Map.
3. Engineer's 3rd Skill 1 Form and 3 Form have increased duration.

notes.title: Update V0.25
notes.content:
Content Update：
1. Added the count of Production Arcane Dust in the building Introduction UI, and modified the UI of the upgraded building description.
2. Added the global Arcane Dust production quantity in the lower right corner.
3. Added the movement speed of the Barracks Gathering Flag in the game settings.
4. Added the function of adjustable viewing in the game settings.
5. Add hints for mana recovering value.
6. Added UI prompt when a building is destroyed.
7. The level entry UI is now not displayed in tutorial levels.
8. Added the smoothing visual effect when the barracks assembly flag moves.9. Added the function of player custom key in the game settings.

Bug Fixed：
1. Fixed an issue where the Barrack’s branch would not inherit the gathering location when upgraded.
2. Fixed the problem that guardian sometimes would inheri EXP when the save was read.
3. Fixed the issue that the introduction could not be displayed when the branch was upgraded.

Balance Adjustments:
1. Balance the difficulty of tenth to twelfth rounds of the fourth level.
2. Enhance the movement speed, attack power and health of the blade dancer.

notes.title: update V0.24
notes.content:
Content Update:
1. During the battle phase, added hints when the enemy wave start.
2. In tutorial level, added the achievement of reading all stone tablets.
3. Optimized the experience of tutorial levels and added more hints.
4. Added hints for stun and fear state.

Fixed issues:
1. Fixed the issue of repeatedly entering the main interface after finishing level.
2. Fixed the issue that the game settings option could not be saved properly in the level.
3. Fixed the issue that the buttons in the interface of the tutorial were misplaced.
4. Fixed the issue that Fear, Crystal Guard, Return Home, and Ability Power could not be used.
5. Disabled the building node display key in the combat state.
6. Fixed the text display issue in the tutorial level.
7. Fixed the issue that pressing the build button continuously caused the building to fail to succeed.
8. Fixed the issue that the crystal cluster was not displayed after the workshop was upgraded.
9. Fixed the issue that the new enemy icon in the level was not displayed properly.
10. Reconstructed the effective logic of Ranger skill 1, which is now more stable.
11. Fixed an issue that you could use collisions bug to construct buildings during combat phase.
12. Fixed an issue that ally units spawned by core skills and upgrades could not disappear normally at the end of the combat phase.
13. Fixed an issue that skill return home would jam the Guardian into the terrain.

Balance Adjustments:
1. The 2nd wave of monsters in the tutorial level drops more arcane dust.
2. Nerfed the wave 6 in the level 4.
3. Reduced the radius of the Flame Shaman's damage aura.
4. Cannon Turret increases attack speed and base damage.
5. Mage‘s 3rd form blizzard stop movement time shortened.
6. Priest increases the base HP at level4-6.
7. Ranger 2nd skill（all forms） hunting arrow damage increased.
8. Beginning Arcane dust increased in level 4.
9. Ranger’s 1st skill（3rd form） increases the control duration.
10. Blader‘s 1st skill（1st form）reducess CD.
11. Mage’s 1st skill（2nd form）increases CD.
12. The 4th level achievement is required to get 150,000 points now.
13. The duration of the priest's skill is halved by cost，effect time and cd.
14. Guardian‘s out battle movement speed is increased.
15. Barrack Gathering Banner movement speed increased. (Game settings that can be adjusted for its speed will be added later.)
16. Increased the fear buff duration of the core skill Fear（all levels）.

notes.content:
Balance Updates:
1. Reduced the difficulty of the first level ,Snow Mountain
2. Reduced the mana consumption of most core skills.
3. Reduced base range and splash damage of Cannon Turret.
4. Reduced the direct damage of projectiles Which spawned by Priest's Ultimate Skill(Light Form).

Content Updates:
1. Added a tutorial for enter level interface.
2. Monsters that appear for the first time will now have icon prompts.
3. More helpful hints have been added to the Tuition level.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed the display problem of the Guardian model on the table on the initial interface.

notes.content:

5. Nerfed the direct magic damage caused by the Clergy Ultimate, Aether Incarnate - Light.

notes.title: v0.21 update!
notes.content:
New Content updates

A new map, Deep Forest.
There will be a variety of different goblin enemy and new mechanics that are sure to surprise you.
A new Guardian, skilled in the use of ritual and enchantment magic, the Priest.
A new branch of the tower, the Arcane Tower, which brings more Arcane Dust income through enemy deaths
A new branch of the Barracks that heals and strengthens other friendly units, Temple.
And 10 upgrade options that can be purchased.

In terms of functionality, we have added an intra-office archiving system, which can now be automatically archived after the end of each wave.
Based on feedback from some of our players, we've added more hints about what to do in the game.
Added a new unlocking system for Steam achievements.
In addition, for gamepad players, we have added a full set of controller operation adaptations.
